kiel-selent-lake-hohwacht-short-day.title: Kiel · Selent Lake and Hohwacht Short Day
kiel-selent-lake-hohwacht-short-day.slogan: A 137 km loop out of Selent lake shore
kiel-selent-lake-hohwacht-short-day.story: A compact water-and-bends ride for an afternoon with good light. The best part sits around Selent lake shore, Lütjenburg snack stop, Hohwacht water stop, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Selent lake shore → Lütjenburg snack stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Lütjenburg snack stop → Hohwacht water stop
scenicChapters.narrative: 15 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.
